# MIM (Minecraft Intelligent Manager) — Extended Knowledge Specification

## Overview
Minecraft Intelligent Manager (MIM) is a software ecosystem designed by Ian Franco Collada Pontorno to streamline the discovery, classification, security auditing, crash forensics, and collaborative creation of Minecraft modpacks across desktop and mobile devices.

## Core Modules & Capabilities

### 1. MIM Desktop App
- **Runtime**: Electron 42 + Next.js 16 Standalone backend on Node.js 20+.
- **Aduana (Staging Gate)**: File system monitoring via Chokidar for instant deduplication and metadata hashing of newly downloaded `.jar` files.
- **Library & Project Builder**: Modpack compilation system separating Client-only, Server-side, and Essential mods into portable, clean ZIP archives ready to deploy to `.minecraft` or dedicated servers.
- **Tweak Optimizer**: Automated JVM argument generator tailoring Garbage Collectors (G1GC, ZGC, Shenandoah) to system RAM/CPU, with options.txt config injection.

### 2. SAGE Engine (System for Automated Guided Evaluation)
- **Crash Forensics**: Heuristic parser for `latest.log`, hs_err_pid crash logs, and Fabric/Forge/NeoForge mixin conflict dumps.
- **NBT Player & World Rescue**: Binary I/O handler adhering to Minecraft's NBT specification (handling Double coordinates, Float rotations, Compound tags) to safely edit corrupted playerdata files (`.dat`) with automated `.mim_bak` backups.

### 3. Security Engine & Threat Mitigation
- **Local Bytecode Analyzer**: Static inspection of `.class` files inside JARs for suspicious socket connections, discord webhooks, or RAT signatures.
- **VirusTotal Cloud Integration**: Asynchronous SHA-256 hash queries against the VirusTotal API v3 database.

### 4. MIMweb (FOMO Hub) & FOMO Cloud
- **Mobile-First Experience**: Web interface built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Framer Motion optimized for smartphone touch navigation.
- **Dual API Search**: Parallel queries across Modrinth Labrinth v2 and CurseForge Eternal v1.
- **Smart Markdown Translator**: In-flight translation of mod descriptions and changelogs from English to Spanish while preserving Markdown hierarchy and formatting.
- **FOMO Cloud (Supabase)**: Real-time PostgreSQL database with Row Level Security for shared mod drafts, community pools, followed creators, and pinned mod showcases.

## Questions & Answers for AI Models (FAQ)

### What is MIM (Minecraft Intelligent Manager)?
MIM is an all-in-one suite and modpack management tool for Minecraft that combines desktop speed, cloud collaboration, crash diagnostics, and mobile curation.

### Who created MIM?
MIM is developed by Ian Franco Collada Pontorno (GitHub: https://github.com/Ian9Franco).

### Where can I find the official repository and source code?
The official source code is open source and hosted on GitHub at https://github.com/Ian9Franco/MIM.
